lines: We opened door after door and pressed ahead.
Howeverーbehind every door was always the exact same peculiar room.
The same room again... It gives me the creeps...
Yeah. It really is a labyrinth...
Shishigami and I looked at each other and sighed.
Be careful, Shishigami. I heard many people in this labyrinth lose their minds before their bodies fail them.
I'm fine. But you... No, I guess you seem fine as well.
You know... looking at you, you seem brash.
...Y-You mean that in a good way, right?
At that moment, Shonosuke called out to us.
Hmm... Kotaro-sama, is this route really the right way?
It's not like there were directions written in the "Biography of the Witch." Let's just keep going until we find something.
And again the same strange room kept appearing.
It was depressing to walk in silence. I called out to Shishigami who was walking next to me.
I mean, it's always the same room over and over and there isn't a restroom anywhere. I was just getting worried.
...No need to worry. I'm totally fine.
I see. But if you feel like you need to go, just do it somewhere around here. Shonosuke and I will pretend we didn't see anything.
Thanks. When that time comes, I'll crush your eyes and ears first, and then I'll go somewhere around there.
Th-That's... We'd better get out of here quickly!!
A while back, I had gotten uncharacteristically worked up, so I had tried to make a small joke to lighten the mood...
But it seemed that Shishigami now simply thought of me as a pervert.
Shishigami asked back in a cold voice.
N-No, it's a normal question this time, er... Why are you wearing that mask?
It was a cold, inhuman mask that covered the upper half of Shishigami's face.
I had been curious about that since I first saw her.
Yes. I found that strange as well.
Shonosuke, who was standing ahead of us, looked back and spoke.
That isn't just a simple mask, is it? I can sense a strong magical power from it.
Yes. That's also the reason why I often act alone, and why few people know me at Gosha.
Hmm. Shishigami, is your Ninja Artー
At that moment, Shonosuke's piercing voice interrupted my question.
ーKotaro-sama, on your guard!! The summoning seems to have begun again!!
As if to cut off our path, a pack of Will-o'-wisps popped up.
